header.syncAll: Download all data for offline use

hero.offlineText: Saved data is shown. New sales, payments and refunds will wait in the queue and send themselves when the connection is back.
hero.neverSynced: Offline data hasn't been downloaded yet — tap the button below while you have internet.
hero.preparing: Getting ready: counting how much data to download…
hero.waitingNetwork: No internet. The download will resume by itself when it's back.
hero.throttled: The server asked us to slow down. Continuing in {{seconds}} s.
hero.partial: Some data couldn't be downloaded. Tap again — what's already saved will be skipped.
hero.throttledEnd: The server limited the number of requests. Everything downloaded is saved — try again in a minute.

queue.title: Send queue
queue.empty: The queue is empty — everything has been sent.
queue.footer: Operations go out one at a time, in the order they were created. Resending is safe: the server never performs the same operation twice.
queue.removeDescription: The operation will not be sent to the server.
queue.removeMaybeSent: The operation will not be sent. But the connection dropped and the server may have already accepted it — check the transactions list.

data.title: Saved on this device
data.footer: The number on the right is how many records you can open without internet. The newest ones are saved; the rest are available online.

storage.title: Device storage
storage.clearDescription: Downloaded data will be removed from this device — without internet the screens will be empty until you sync again. The queue of unsent operations is kept.

toast.complete: Everything is downloaded — you can work offline
toast.partial: Not everything was downloaded — tap “Sync everything” again
toast.throttled: The server limited requests. What was downloaded is saved — try again in a minute
toast.cancelled: Sync stopped. What was downloaded is saved

offlineHint.text: This data hasn't been downloaded yet.

logout.title: Sign out?
logout.description_one: {{count}} operation in the queue hasn't been sent. If you sign out now, it will be deleted from this device and never reach the server.
logout.description_other: {{count}} operations in the queue haven't been sent. If you sign out now, they will be deleted from this device and never reach the server.
